scope: D003 fault-injection harness for the FMM epsilon path (P05-S2). Test-only. No production solver change. Nothing under S4/, Makefile*, or setup.py is modified.
origin_note: Historical sources are copied read-only from a path outside this repository. The source paths below are recorded for provenance only; the harness never reads them at run time (verified by strace, see checkpoints/p05/P05_S2_TEST_HARNESS.md section 3.3).

files.role: history driver, base of the consolidated driver
history injector, base of the consolidated injector
history strict/baseline matrix script, kept for reference; not executed by the harness
S1B patched driver; byte reference for the default-output check

consolidated_sources.note: Exact hashes are recorded by each run's SHA256SUMS, not here, so that this file does not change when the sources are edited under review.

rounds_in_consolidated_driver.change: requested-but-unreached injection fails; swallowed injection fails; HITCOUNT line

known_limits: LinearSolve injection is not covered: needs a production-side seam (not implemented, awaiting approval).
S4FMM_STAGE, S4FMM_PLAN_CALL, S4FMM_ALLOC, S4FMM_EXEC are echoed in the header line only; the injector does not read them (S1B appendix d.3).
The S5 and S5b driver versions were derived from diffs; no independent original copy of the S5 driver exists (S5b s5b-driver-base.PROVENANCE.txt).
